info.title: OpenVibe.Quest API
info.description: Routes of OpenVibe.Quest as the OpenVibe contracts describe them (openvibe-contracts 0.263.1): each operation lists the capabilities it performs; a token for the service's audience must carry one of them unless the route is open. Generated by openvibe-contracts lib/openapi.js; do not edit.

get.summary: Define your app's own quests on OpenVibe.Quest (the SDK's moddable quests): PUT /api/v1/app-quests/:slug with quest.app-quest-request@1 creates or replaces one (at most 20 per project), GET /api/v1/ap
get.description: **quest.app_quest.manage** (public): Define your app's own quests on OpenVibe.Quest (the SDK's moddable quests): PUT /api/v1/app-quests/:slug with quest.app-quest-request@1 creates or replaces one (at most 20 per project), GET /api/v1/app-quests lists your project's, DELETE /api/v1/app-quests/:slug retires one (its completions and badges stay). Steps count the project's own events app.<project_key>.<name> at OpenVibe.Events whose actor is a person; only production events count. The reward is a badge named for your app; app quests never pay OpenCoins.

event_type.description: One of the app's own event types (app.<project_key>.<name>), as it publishes them at OpenVibe.Events.

errors.problem.v1.title: Problem
errors.problem.v1.description: RFC 9457 problem details (application/problem+json) with a stable OpenVibe error code and trace identifiers. The legacy 'error' string is allowed during migration so existing clients keep working.

error.description: Deprecated compatibility field: same text as title/detail for clients that read {error}.

quest.app-quest-request.v1.title: QuestAppQuestRequest
quest.app-quest-request.v1.description: quest.app-quest-request@1: PUT /api/v1/app-quests/:slug on OpenVibe.Quest with an app token (capability quest.app_quest.manage). A developer app defines a quest on its own project's events: each step counts events of type app.<project_key>.<name> whose envelope actor is a person (the app publishing on_behalf_of them). The badge is the only reward: app quests never pay OpenCoins. Only production apps' events are counted (Events never hands sandbox events to first-party consumers).

event_type.description: One of the app's own event types (app.<project_key>.<name>), as it publishes them at OpenVibe.Events.

url.description: Where a person does the steps: the app's own page.

status.description: retired: kept with its completions and badges, no longer counted or listed. Default active.

quest.app-quest.v1.title: QuestAppQuest
quest.app-quest.v1.description: quest.app-quest@1: one app quest as OpenVibe.Quest keeps it (the answer to PUT and GET /api/v1/app-quests[/:slug]). id is app.<project_key>.<slug>; badge.id is the same id; completions counts the people who finished it.

app.description: The app that last defined it.

event_type.description: One of the app's own event types (app.<project_key>.<name>), as it publishes them at OpenVibe.Events.

openvibeToken.description: An OpenVibe Network token for this service: a person's token, an app token (client credentials, audience of the service) or a first-party service token. Its `cap` claim must include the capability the operation names.
